mapper.sql: select t.id, t.project_id, t.title, t.description, t.priority, t.task_type, t.status, t.remark, t.create_dept, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.del_flag, t.tenant_id, t.template_id, st.template_name, t.overall_score, t.compliance_rate, t.passed_file_count, t.total_file_count from task_management t left join sys_template st on t.template_id = st.template_id
mapper.insert:
insert into task_management
project_id, title, description, priority, task_type, status, remark, create_dept, create_by, tenant_id, template_id, create_time
#{projectId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{priority}, #{taskType}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createDept}, #{createBy}, #{tenantId}, #{templateId}, sysdate()
mapper.delete: update task_management set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT status as `key`, COUNT(*) as `value` FROM task_management WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY status
SELECT task_type as `key`, COUNT(*) as `value` FROM task_management WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY task_type

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') as date,CONCAT(YEAR(create_time), '-W', LPAD(WEEK(create_time, 1), 2, '0')) as date,DATE(create_time) as date, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, create_time, CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND update_time IS NOT NULL THEN update_time ELSE NOW() END)) as avgDuration, COUNT(*) as count FROM task_management WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')YEAR(create_time), WEEK(create_time, 1)DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(*) as count, task_type as type FROM task_management WHERE del_flag = '0' AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') BETWEEN #{startMonth} AND #{endMonth} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m'), task_type ORDER BY month ASC, task_type ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN MONTH(create_time) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1' WHEN MONTH(create_time) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN MONTH(create_time) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END as quarter, COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as success, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as fail, ROUND(IF(COUNT(*) = 0, 0, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)), 2) as successRate, ROUND(IF(COUNT(*) = 0, 0, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)), 2) as failRate FROM task_management WHERE del_flag = '0' AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y') = #{year} GROUP BY CASE WHEN MONTH(create_time) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1' WHEN MONTH(create_time) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN MONTH(create_time) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END ORDER BY quarter ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_management WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = #{status}

SELECT -- 统计通过数量：未删除 + 任务类型为代码规范检查 + 状态完成 + 合规率=1.00 SUM(CASE WHEN del_flag = '0' AND task_type = 'code_standard_check' AND status = 'completed' AND compliance_rate = 1.00 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed, -- 统计未通过数量：未删除 + 任务类型为代码规范检查 + 状态完成 + 合规率≠1.00 SUM(CASE WHEN del_flag = '0' AND task_type = 'code_standard_check' AND status = 'completed' AND compliance_rate != 1.00 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM task_management WHERE del_flag = '0' AND task_type = 'code_standard_check' AND status = 'completed'
AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT CASE WHEN HOUR(login_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 1 THEN '0-2点' WHEN HOUR(login_date) BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN '2-4点' WHEN HOUR(login_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 5 THEN '4-6点' WHEN HOUR(login_date) BETWEEN 6 AND 7 THEN '6-8点' WHEN HOUR(login_date) BETWEEN 8 AND 9 THEN '8-10点' WHEN HOUR(login_date) BETWEEN 10 AND 11 THEN '10-12点' WHEN HOUR(login_date) BETWEEN 12 AND 13 THEN '12-14点' WHEN HOUR(login_date) BETWEEN 14 AND 15 THEN '14-16点' WHEN HOUR(login_date) BETWEEN 16 AND 17 THEN '16-18点' WHEN HOUR(login_date) BETWEEN 18 AND 19 THEN '18-20点' WHEN HOUR(login_date) BETWEEN 20 AND 21 THEN '20-22点' ELSE '22-24点' END AS timeSlot, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS count FROM sys_user WHERE
DATE(login_date) = #{date}
DATE(login_date) = CURRENT_DATE
GROUP BY timeSlot ORDER BY MIN(HOUR(login_date))

SELECT CASE WHEN HOUR(create_time) BETWEEN 0 AND 1 THEN '0' WHEN HOUR(create_time) BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN '2' WHEN HOUR(create_time) BETWEEN 4 AND 5 THEN '4' WHEN HOUR(create_time) BETWEEN 6 AND 7 THEN '6' WHEN HOUR(create_time) BETWEEN 8 AND 9 THEN '8' WHEN HOUR(create_time) BETWEEN 10 AND 11 THEN '10' WHEN HOUR(create_time) BETWEEN 12 AND 13 THEN '12' WHEN HOUR(create_time) BETWEEN 14 AND 15 THEN '14' WHEN HOUR(create_time) BETWEEN 16 AND 17 THEN '16' WHEN HOUR(create_time) BETWEEN 18 AND 19 THEN '18' WHEN HOUR(create_time) BETWEEN 20 AND 21 THEN '20' ELSE '22' END AS hour, COUNT(*) AS count FROM task_management WHERE del_flag = '0' AND (DATE(create_time) = #{date} OR DATE(update_time) = #{date}) GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM sys_user WHERE DATE(login_date) = CURRENT_DATE
